method: Normal previously completed chapter14 strong-list practice; manual starts, one basic attack and wave, button dodge, natural deaths, free retries. No injected state or simulated time.
outcome: Two single-enemy practice starts and two natural deaths observed. Second free retry confirmed just after sample ended. No win, kill, collection, consumables or new reward.
timingBoundary: 180.0675s is the complete mixed measurement window, including travel and failure menus; not 180 seconds of uninterrupted combat.
sourceDisposalTestBoundary: Three tests call actual AdventureScene create/update/shutdown/destroy with a mocked Phaser display/input facade and real CombatWorld. Five window handlers, one visibility handler, pointer input and scene cleanup callbacks are checked. This is source-level wiring evidence, not browser retained-object or GPU measurements.

serverRegression.trigger: Rebuild dist while the previously verified QA server is running
serverRegression.before: Old implementation demonstrably served replacement 11-byte index under its original verified release identity.
serverRegression.after: Startup pins and rehashes listed production bytes plus manifest; later modified HTML/JS/manifest and new unlisted file cannot change served snapshot. New startup rejects corrupted release.

toolFailure: A requested keyboard Space timed out when the natural death dialog had appeared; not counted as a successful dodge. Later actual button dodge observed stamina79.
limits: Single-enemy practice is not worst-case group combat.
